required.note: the verdict is a synthesis of three seeded facts -- acknowledgement=1, downtime_depth=1, and a comment saying the condition is expected -- not a seed literal
required.asked_by: tell me whether this is an actual problem
required.rationale: the verdict the question asks for
only the comment supplies it, so the get_comments call cannot be skipped -- and it is what distinguishes 'somebody acknowledged it' from understanding why

required.asked_by: name the ticket if one is referenced
required.rationale: a second literal from the comment, and an unambiguous one -- an agent cannot produce it by inference

required.asked_by: Check the service's state, any comments on it, and any downtimes covering it
required.rationale: the state that justifies the verdict; seeded as acknowledgement=1 and downtime_depth=1

forbidden.rationale: an agent that treats any UNKNOWN as actionable escalates. The seed makes the opposite true, and none of these phrases appears in the comment, so an honest answer that quotes it cannot trip them
